entities.name: Tolarian Academy
entities.description: Magical institution on Dominaria founded by Urza and Barrin on Tolaria in 3285 AR.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Co-founder and headmaster of the Academy.

entities.name: Barrin
entities.description: Co-founder and Mage Master; destroyed the island while grieving his daughter Hanna.

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: Student and later chancellor; stranded in the time disaster.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: Used Urza's time machine to save Jhoira.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: Student trapped in a slow-time bubble and rescued.

entities.name: Ertai
entities.description: Former student resurrected as a Phyrexian who took control of Lat-Nam.

entities.name: Tolarian Time Rift
entities.description: Rift created by the time machine failure.

entities.name: Society of Mishra
entities.description: Secret cult of Phyrexian sympathizers excised after the New Phyrexian Invasion.

events.summary: Urza and Barrin found the Tolarian Academy on Tolaria.
events.quote: founded on the island of Tolaria by Urza and Barrin in 3285 AR

events.summary: Karn uses Urza's time machine to save Jhoira; the machine fails, destroying the first academy and creating the Tolarian Time Rift.
events.quote: destroying the first academy and leaving Tolaria a shattered temporal landscape

events.summary: Urza and Barrin escape with students; Karn rescues twenty more; Jhoira is stranded.
Ten years later Urza, Barrin and Karn return, find Jhoira alive and Teferi trapped, and rescue him.
events.quote: discovered Jhoira still alive, and Teferi trapped in a slow-time bubble

events.summary: The Invasion of Tolaria is ended by Barrin, students, Jhoira, Teferi and Shiv allies.
events.quote: the Invasion of Tolaria began, with K'rrik 's negators swarming over the island

events.summary: Barrin destroys the island with its occupants while grieving his daughter Hanna.
events.quote: Barrin destroyed the whole island along with all of its occupants

events.summary: Ertai, resurrected as a Phyrexian, takes control of the Lat-Nam academy.
events.quote: took control of the academy at Lat-Nam
